Cloudflare app runtime contract:
- Future production runtime is Cloudflare Workers.
- Cloudflare D1 scaffolding is available but optional.
- Add a D1 binding named DB only when the requested application needs persistent server-side data.
- Make schema changes in src/db/schema.ts, then run npm run db:generate before finishing when migrations/meta/_journal.json exists.

- Treat generated D1 migration files as append-only: never edit, rename, reorder, or delete an existing migration; only add newly generated files.
- Every SQL migration file must contain executable SQL; never create an empty or comment-only migration. If a required no-op migration must be retained, use SELECT 1;.
- Use expand-contract migrations: add and backfill new schema first, and keep the currently deployed Worker compatible with the expanded schema.
- Never drop or rename tables or columns, delete production rows, remove the DB binding, or recreate the database during an automated build.
- Whenever the app uses D1, always create realistic sample/demo rows in seeds/local.sql (never leave tables empty; never put seed rows in production migrations).
- After creating or updating seeds, apply them to the preview D1 database with npm run db:seed:remote (or wrangler d1 execute <preview-database-name> --remote --file=./seeds/local.sql) so Studio Database shows rows.
- npm run db:seed:local only affects the sandbox local D1 and does not update Studio Database; never claim seeding succeeded for the user-visible database after a local-only seed.
- Seed SQL must be safe to re-run (prefer INSERT OR IGNORE / upserts) so repeated seeding does not fail on unique constraints.
- Do not persist production app data on the filesystem.
- Avoid Node-only runtime APIs in app and Worker code.
- Only add libraries that are compatible with Cloudflare Workers; avoid Node-only packages or packages that require unsupported Node built-ins.
- Auth (sign-up, sign-in, sessions, password reset): use a Cloudflare Workers-compatible library such as better-auth with the D1 adapter; enable the required wrangler compatibility flags (nodejs_compat or nodejs_als for better-auth). Do not use Node-only auth stacks (bcrypt/argon2 native bindings, Express session middleware, Prisma-only auth kits).
- Prefer the library's supported password hashing. User request:
Build a responsive Indonesian-language web application, Sistem SPP & Kelayakan Ujian, for SDIT AT-TAQWIM (one institution, one school level). Treat the attached PRD_TO_MVP_Level_2_Sistem_SPP_Kelayakan_Ujian.md v1.0 as the source of truth for all detailed fields, permissions, workflows, acceptance criteria, entities, edge cases, performance targets, and release requirements. Deliver the complete Level 2 end-to-end administrative MVP, not an academic management system.

Design: use the supplied school logo prominently at the top-left of the header/navigation and in the footer and exam cards. Sample its dark forest green for primary navigation, buttons and accents; use white/light neutral backgrounds and complementary soft tones for cards/highlights. Follow the supplied dashboard reference for layout, typography and overall feel: compact grouped sidebar, top bar, metric cards, small charts, structured tables and supporting panels, adapted to school workflows rather than recruitment content. Keep the interface modern, clean, professional, accessible and responsive, with a mobile-friendly guardian portal.

Access and foundation: authentication, logout, secure sessions, admin password reset, account activation, users, roles and backend-enforced permissions matching the PRD matrix for Super Admin, Kepala Sekolah, Keuangan/TU, Wali Kelas, Guru and Wali Murid. Restrict guardians to linked children and staff to authorized records. Manage students, guardians, classes and academic years with prescribed fields, searching, filtering and pagination. Require unique NIS and optional unique NISN, at least one guardian per student, multiple children per guardian, one operational active academic year, retained history and no new invoices for inactive students.

Finance: manage uniform school-wide SPP by academic year, generation/due dates and active configuration. Preserve amounts of existing invoices when master rates change. Generate monthly invoices uniquely by student/month/academic year. Support BELUM BAYAR, MENUNGGU VERIFIKASI, LUNAS and JATUH TEMPO. No partial monthly invoice payments; one transaction may settle multiple months at exactly their combined amount. Record cash payments and manual bank transfers with required validated proof, transfer date, bank, amount and notes. Transfers remain unpaid pending TU verification; acceptance settles invoices and recalculates eligibility, rejection requires a reason and restores unpaid status. Prevent duplicate/paid-invoice payments and concurrent verification errors. Support payment cancellation and audited changes. Provide PDF/print receipts containing transaction, student, class, billing months, amount, method, date and officer.

Collection: real-time arrears by student/class/year/month, overdue duration and risk, with sorting by amount, month count and age. Configurable default risk thresholds: AMAN 0 months, PERHATIAN 1, MENUNGGAK 2, PRIORITAS 3+. Configurable Click-to-WhatsApp reminders using guardian name, student name, class, arrears, exam name and deadline variables; staff send messages themselves, with no WhatsApp API automation.

Exams: dynamic exam types and periods including academic year, semester, dates, administrative deadline, required paid-through SPP month, status and guardian-card-download toggle. Automatically calculate BELUM DIEVALUASI, BELUM LAYAK, LAYAK UJIAN or LAYAK UJIAN - DISPENSASI. All required invoices through the cutoff, including older unpaid months, must be settled for ordinary eligibility. Never manually override eligibility; use approved dispensation. Recalculate after payment approval/cancellation, exam requirement changes and dispensation approval/revocation. Separate financial status from exam eligibility. Administrative restrictions must not automatically determine exclusion from educational activities.

Dispensation: guardian applications reviewed by TU then decided by the principal, and internal TU applications sent to the principal. Final approval belongs only to Kepala Sekolah. Capture student, exam, arrears, reason, ability to pay, promised payment date, notes, applicant/reviewer/approver and PRD lifecycle statuses. Approval unlocks exam administration without settling invoices. Monitor overdue promises, notify guardians and TU, and preserve student history. Handle duplicate applications, expiry and revocation according to PRD.

Exam documents: generate cards only for eligible or approved-dispensation students, with school logo, student photo/name/NIS/NISN/class, unique participant number per exam period, exam/year and secure token-based QR. Print individually, by class or for all eligible students; guardian downloads follow the period setting. Support cancellation after eligibility changes and invalidate old QR cards. QR validation requires authorized login and shows student name, class, participant number, exam period, card status and valid/invalid, without embedding sensitive personal or financial data.

Guardian portal: dashboard, all linked children, invoices/arrears, payments and proof upload, payment history, exam status, allowed card downloads, characteristic forms, dispensations, notifications and profile.

Characteristic forms: grade-level shared templates and form builder with yes/no, multiple choice, 1–5 scale, short text and long text. Wali Kelas can create/edit templates, open/close periods, review results and reopen answers. Only eligible or approved-dispensation students have form access. Guardians complete forms with children and may edit before deadline; lock afterwards unless reopened. Provide completion counts, individual results/print and class summaries.

Management: finance dashboard with invoiced totals, current-month payments, arrears, overdue students, pending transfers, priority students and charts; principal dashboard with student/eligibility counts, dispensations, arrears by class and trends, payment trends and pending approvals. Reports for SPP, payments, arrears, exams/cards, dispensations/promises and characteristic completion, using the PRD filters and screen/PDF/Excel/CSV/print outputs. Audit login, payment creation/edit/cancellation/verification, SPP and exam-rule changes, dispensation submission/approval, card generation and permission changes, recording actor, role, action, module, reference, before/after, timestamp and IP when available. Follow the PRD backoffice menu groups: Dashboard, Master Data, Keuangan, Ujian, Karakteristik, Laporan and System.

Engineering and acceptance: implement the prescribed relational entities and retain historical data across class transfers, departures and year changes. Handle duplicate transfers/generation, concurrency, invalid evidence, repeated dispensation and changed exam requirements after card issuance. Secure password hashing, production HTTPS, CSRF protection, secure sessions, upload validation, safe QR tokens and private financial information. Target page loads <3s, search <2s, individual eligibility <1s, class eligibility <5s and standard reports <10s; 99% operational-hours uptime; daily backups with at least seven-day retention (30 recommended for production). Verify every PRD acceptance criterion and both normal-payment and arrears-to-dispensation workflows through updated cards, forms, dashboards and reports, without extra spreadsheets/manual tracking for core operations. Follow the seven PRD development phases and release checklist.

Exclude all Level 3 payment gateway features: Xendit, automatic QRIS/VA/e-wallet payments, webhooks, automatic reconciliation and settlement. Also exclude full academics, attendance, grades, e-learning, payroll, library, multi-school/foundation and native mobile apps. Keep Level 2 foundations compatible with later gateway development without implementing it now.

# PRD to MVP Level 2
## Sistem SPP & Kelayakan Ujian Sekolah

**Status Dokumen:** Final Draft MVP  
**Versi:** 1.0  
**Level Produk:** Level 2  
**Kategori Produk:** Sistem Administrasi SPP & Kelayakan Ujian  
**Platform:** Web Application Responsive  
**Target Pengguna:** Sekolah satu institusi / satu jenjang  
**Fokus Utama:** Mengurangi tunggakan SPP dan mempercepat administrasi ujian  
**Payment Gateway:** Tidak termasuk pada Level 2  
**Posisi Produk:** Level 2 merupakan MVP utama sebelum pengembangan Level 3 Payment Gateway

---

# 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

Sistem SPP & Kelayakan Ujian Level 2 merupakan aplikasi berbasis web yang mengintegrasikan pengelolaan SPP, pembayaran, tunggakan, penagihan, kelayakan ujian, dispensasi, kartu ujian, Portal Wali Murid, dan Form Karakteristik Anak.

Masalah utama yang ingin diselesaikan adalah keterlambatan dan tunggakan SPP yang dapat menimbulkan kerugian besar bagi sekolah. Jika tidak dipantau dan ditangani secara sistematis, tunggakan dapat terakumulasi hingga puluhan bahkan ratusan juta rupiah.

Pada proses manual, sekolah sering menghadapi:

- Pembayaran dicatat pada media terpisah.
- Tunggakan baru diketahui menjelang ujian.
- Wali murid tidak memiliki akses transparan terhadap tagihan.
- Penagihan dilakukan satu per satu.
- Pemeriksaan kelayakan siswa untuk memperoleh kartu ujian dilakukan manual.
- Dispensasi tidak selalu memiliki histori yang terdokumentasi.
- Kartu ujian dibuat secara terpisah.
- Form Karakteristik Anak masih menggunakan proses manual.
- Kepala sekolah tidak memiliki dashboard real-time terkait tunggakan.

Level 2 dirancang untuk mengatasi masalah tersebut melalui alur digital end-to-end tanpa Payment Gateway.

---

# 2. Latar Belakang Bisnis

Sekolah membutuhkan sistem yang mampu meningkatkan kedisiplinan pembayaran SPP tanpa menghilangkan fleksibilitas kebijakan sekolah terhadap kondisi wali murid.

Proses yang berjalan saat ini:

1. Siswa memiliki kewajiban pembayaran SPP.
2. Menjelang ujian seperti UTS, UAS, Try Out, atau Ujian Sekolah, sekolah menentukan batas pelunasan.
3. Siswa yang memenuhi persyaratan administrasi memperoleh kartu ujian.
4. Siswa juga memperoleh Form Karakteristik Anak.
5. Siswa yang belum memenuhi kewajiban belum memperoleh dokumen tersebut.
6. Jika terdapat kondisi khusus, Kepala Sekolah dapat memberikan dispensasi.

Level 2 mengubah proses tersebut menjadi sistem digital yang tetap mempertahankan kewenangan sekolah.

---

# 3. Tujuan Produk

## 3.1 Tujuan Utama

> **Mengurangi jumlah siswa menunggak dan total nominal tunggakan SPP melalui pencatatan, monitoring, penagihan, transparansi kepada wali murid, dan integrasi dengan administrasi ujian.**

## 3.2 Tujuan Sekunder

Sistem harus membantu sekolah untuk:

- Mengetahui tunggakan secara real-time.
- Mengetahui siswa prioritas penagihan.
- Memberikan akses tagihan kepada wali murid.
- Mempermudah pembayaran tunai dan transfer.
- Mempermudah verifikasi transfer.
- Memberikan reminder melalui WhatsApp.
- Menghitung kelayakan ujian secara otomatis.
- Mengelola dispensasi secara terstruktur.
- Membuat kartu ujian secara digital.
- Menyediakan QR untuk validasi kartu.
- Mendigitalisasi Form Karakteristik Anak.
- Memberikan dashboard manajemen.
- Menyediakan laporan terstruktur.
- Menyimpan jejak perubahan melalui Audit Log.

---

│                    │

MVP dianggap selesai apabila alur tersebut berjalan end-to-end tanpa kebutuhan file Excel atau pencatatan manual tambahan untuk proses utama.

---

# 9. Business Rules Utama

## BR-001 — Master SPP
Nominal SPP berlaku sama untuk seluruh siswa pada versi MVP.

## BR-002 — Cicilan Invoice
Satu invoice bulanan tidak dapat dibayar sebagian.

## BR-003 — Multi-Month Payment
Beberapa invoice dapat dibayar dalam satu transaksi.

## BR-004 — Verifikasi Transfer
Pembayaran transfer belum dianggap lunas sebelum diverifikasi Keuangan/TU.

## BR-005 — Persyaratan Ujian
Setiap periode ujian mempunyai batas bulan SPP yang wajib lunas.

## BR-006 — Tunggakan Lama
Tunggakan pada bulan lama tetap memengaruhi kelayakan.

Contoh:

```text
Agustus      BELUM
September    LUNAS
Oktober      LUNAS
November     LUNAS
```

Jika syarat ujian adalah lunas sampai November, siswa tetap **BELUM LAYAK**.

## BR-007 — Status Pembayaran vs Kelayakan
Status pembayaran dan status ujian harus dipisahkan.

```text
SPP:
BELUM LUNAS

Ujian:
LAYAK UJIAN - DISPENSASI
```

## BR-008 — Override
Status Eligibility tidak boleh diubah manual. Override dilakukan melalui dispensasi.

## BR-009 — Approval
Approval dispensasi final hanya oleh Kepala Sekolah.

## BR-010 — Akses Kartu
Kartu hanya dapat diterbitkan jika:
- LAYAK UJIAN.
- LAYAK UJIAN - DISPENSASI.

## BR-011 — Akses Form
Form Karakteristik hanya dapat dibuka apabila status ujian sudah layak atau dispensasi.

## BR-012 — Hak Pendidikan
Sistem mengontrol administrasi ujian dan tidak secara otomatis menentukan siswa dilarang mengikuti kegiatan pendidikan.

Given seluruh SPP wajib sudah lunas,

Given siswa BELUM LAYAK,

Given dispensasi disetujui,  
Then status tagihan tetap belum lunas.

## AC-006
Given transfer belum diverifikasi,  
Then invoice belum boleh dianggap lunas.

## AC-007
Given transfer disetujui,  
Then invoice menjadi LUNAS dan Eligibility dihitung ulang.

## AC-008
Given wali memiliki dua anak,  
Then satu akun wali dapat melihat kedua anak.

## AC-009
Given form belum melewati deadline,  
Then wali dapat mengubah jawaban.

## AC-010
Given deadline terlewati,  
Then form terkunci kecuali direopen.

## AC-011
Given kartu memiliki QR valid,  
When user berwenang melakukan scan,  
Then status kartu ditampilkan.

Given user tidak memiliki permission,  
When membuka modul restricted,  
Then sistem menolak akses.

# 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

Sistem SPP & Kelayakan Ujian Level 2 merupakan aplikasi berbasis web yang mengintegrasikan pengelolaan SPP, pembayaran, tunggakan, penagihan, kelayakan ujian, dispensasi, kartu ujian, Portal Wali Murid, dan Form Karakteristik Anak.

Masalah utama yang ingin diselesaikan adalah keterlambatan dan tunggakan SPP yang dapat menimbulkan kerugian besar bagi sekolah. Jika tidak dipantau dan ditangani secara sistematis, tunggakan dapat terakumulasi hingga puluhan bahkan ratusan juta rupiah.

Pada proses manual, sekolah sering menghadapi:

- Pembayaran dicatat pada media terpisah.
- Tunggakan baru diketahui menjelang ujian.
- Wali murid tidak memiliki akses transparan terhadap tagihan.
- Penagihan dilakukan satu per satu.
- Pemeriksaan kelayakan siswa untuk memperoleh kartu ujian dilakukan manual.
- Dispensasi tidak selalu memiliki histori yang terdokumentasi.
- Kartu ujian dibuat secara terpisah.
- Form Karakteristik Anak masih menggunakan proses manual.
- Kepala sekolah tidak memiliki dashboard real-time terkait tunggakan.

Level 2 dirancang untuk mengatasi masalah tersebut melalui alur digital end-to-end tanpa Payment Gateway.

# 2. Latar Belakang Bisnis

Sekolah membutuhkan sistem yang mampu meningkatkan kedisiplinan pembayaran SPP tanpa menghilangkan fleksibilitas kebijakan sekolah terhadap kondisi wali murid.

Proses yang berjalan saat ini:

1. Siswa memiliki kewajiban pembayaran SPP.
2. Menjelang ujian seperti UTS, UAS, Try Out, atau Ujian Sekolah, sekolah menentukan batas pelunasan.
3. Siswa yang memenuhi persyaratan administrasi memperoleh kartu ujian.
4. Siswa juga memperoleh Form Karakteristik Anak.
5. Siswa yang belum memenuhi kewajiban belum memperoleh dokumen tersebut.
6. Jika terdapat kondisi khusus, Kepala Sekolah dapat memberikan dispensasi.

Level 2 mengubah proses tersebut menjadi sistem digital yang tetap mempertahankan kewenangan sekolah.

# 9. Business Rules Utama

## BR-001 — Master SPP
Nominal SPP berlaku sama untuk seluruh siswa pada versi MVP.

## BR-002 — Cicilan Invoice
Satu invoice bulanan tidak dapat dibayar sebagian.

## BR-003 — Multi-Month Payment
Beberapa invoice dapat dibayar dalam satu transaksi.

## BR-004 — Verifikasi Transfer
Pembayaran transfer belum dianggap lunas sebelum diverifikasi Keuangan/TU.

## BR-005 — Persyaratan Ujian
Setiap periode ujian mempunyai batas bulan SPP yang wajib lunas.

## BR-006 — Tunggakan Lama
Tunggakan pada bulan lama tetap memengaruhi kelayakan.

Contoh:

```text
Agustus      BELUM
September    LUNAS
Oktober      LUNAS
November     LUNAS
```

Jika syarat ujian adalah lunas sampai November, siswa tetap **BELUM LAYAK**.

## BR-007 — Status Pembayaran vs Kelayakan
Status pembayaran dan status ujian harus dipisahkan.

```text
SPP:
BELUM LUNAS

Ujian:
LAYAK UJIAN - DISPENSASI
```

## BR-008 — Override
Status Eligibility tidak boleh diubah manual. Override dilakukan melalui dispensasi.

## BR-009 — Approval
Approval dispensasi final hanya oleh Kepala Sekolah.

## BR-010 — Akses Kartu
Kartu hanya dapat diterbitkan jika:
- LAYAK UJIAN.
- LAYAK UJIAN - DISPENSASI.

## BR-011 — Akses Form
Form Karakteristik hanya dapat dibuka apabila status ujian sudah layak atau dispensasi.

## BR-012 — Hak Pendidikan
Sistem mengontrol administrasi ujian dan tidak secara otomatis menentukan siswa dilarang mengikuti kegiatan pendidikan.
